## Toronto Rental Repair Request

A polite but firm message should clearly state the problem, how long it has been happening, the damage risk, and the repair request. Keep the tone neutral and specific.

## Email Draft and Follow-Up Message

### Repair Request Email
Subject: Request for Urgent Repair: Leaking Kitchen Sink

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing to report a leaking kitchen sink in my apartment at [address/unit]. The leak has been getting worse over the past two weeks and is now causing damage to the cabinet below the sink.

Please arrange for the sink to be repaired as soon as possible. I would appreciate a prompt response with the expected timing for the repair.

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Phone Number]
[Unit Number]

### Follow-Up Message After 5 Business Days
Subject: Follow-Up: Leaking Kitchen Sink Repair Request

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m following up on my repair request from [date] regarding the leaking kitchen sink at [address/unit]. The leak is still ongoing and the cabinet damage is worsening.

Please confirm when this will be repaired. Because the issue has continued for two weeks, I would appreciate urgent attention and a clear timeline for next steps.

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Phone Number]
[Unit Number]

## Details to Include in Your Message

- Exact address and unit number
- Date you first noticed the leak
- How long the issue has been worsening
- Where the leak is coming from, if known
- Any damage already caused, especially the cabinet
- Whether the leak affects use of the kitchen or creates safety concerns
- Request for repair and a response timeline
- Photos or video, if you have them
- Best phone number or email for contact

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy Email]
Action: [Button: Copy Follow-Up]
Action: [Button: Add Photos]

## Sources

- Ontario landlord and tenant information: https://www.ontario.ca/page/renting-ontario-your-rights
- Landlord and Tenant Board forms and guidance: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
- Toronto rental housing standards: https://www.toronto.ca/community-people/housing-shelter/rental-housing-standards/
